review_run.feedback: The same owner prompt appears many times (dictation, backup, inbox and assistant batches repeated in 3 to 5 ids), so a judge cannot tell which copy is canonical. Grouping repeats under one id with aliases would cut about half the work. The cands lists are matched on shared words and often miss the real commit, such as Backup and Opus, or hit unrelated commits like 'stale' or 'past work'. Showing the changed file paths and per-commit diffstat would help. Questions and statements have no status field, so I could not record that a question was answered by a doc. Also, I could not verify evidence by reading code in the turn budget, so most 'done' calls rest on commit subjects alone.
